description: Sign-in to agent registration (ADR-0190 D3-h, #3389): this install's id, and the app's hand-off of the one-time connection value to the official Claude Code CLI (two fixed commands, the value kept in the app's own store, never in argv or a log). For the main window's own webview (label `main`) on the bundled (local) origin only, scoped by webview like pty.json. No `remote` entry: a page from the network must never reach it.
